# 50.00 CAD moved from the plain receivable onto customer C001's credit.
#
# A journal entry a bookkeeper makes once they know whose money a receipt was:
# the receivable against itself, one split standing as C001's credit and the
# other taking the amount off the receivable nobody's name was on. No bank
# account is in it, so the credit has no bank side to report.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, two splits on
# Assets:Accounts Receivable, the credit split in a lot of C001's.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_credit_with_no_bank_side_is_listed.py.
2026-01-06 * "Attributed to Acme"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -50.00 CAD
		lot_owner: customer:C001
	Assets:Accounts Receivable 50.00 CAD
